data.title: Takraw joy and heartbreak for Thailand
data.description: The battle for supremacy between Asia’s two sepak takraw powerhouses ended in disappointment for Thailand, as the kingdom’s men’s team — seven-time defending Asian Games champions — lost 2-0 to arch-rivals Malaysia in the gold medal match at Aichi-Nagoya 2026 on Friday.

data.title: Thai footballers target semis, China stand in way
data.description: The Thai men’s Asian Games football team will look to book a place in the final four on Saturday afternoon when they take on group winners China in a mouth-watering quarter-final at the Toyota Stadium in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan.

data.title: 'Genius' Ohashi bids for third Asian Games gold after world record
data.description: TOKYO — Japanese teenager Shin Ohashi moved closer to a hat-trick of Asian Games breaststroke golds after qualifying for the 50m final on Friday, the morning after smashing the 200-metre world record.

data.title: Thailand settle for second as Japan close out in style
data.description: Thailand finished runners-up in Group A of the men's football competition at the Asian Games after a 3-0 defeat to hosts Japan in their final pool match at Toyota Stadium on Wednesday night, a result that had no bearing on either side's passage to the quarter-finals.

data.title: Speed king Puripol smashes into semi-finals
data.description: Thailand's sprint sensation Puripol Boonson roared to within a whisker of history on Thursday, becoming the first Thai ever to break 10 seconds on the Asian Games stage, as sepak takraw booked a shot at double gold in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan.

data.title: Japanese teen smashes swim world record at Asian Games
data.description: NAGOYA, Japan - Japanese 17-year-old Shin Ohashi smashed a swimming world record at his home Asian Games on Thursday, as several teams rounded on organisers over problems dogging the continent’s biggest sporting spectacular.

data.title: Thailand slams ‘chaotic’ Asian Games organisation
data.description: NAGOYA — Thailand is the latest country to speak out about the organisation at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games in Japan, likening it to a “chaotic” game of “musical chairs”.

data.title: ONE Championship: Superlek to vacate flyweight kickboxing title as he vows to return
data.description: Superlek Kiatmoo9 is set to officially announce that he is vacating his ONE Championship flyweight kickboxing world title, the Bangkok Post understands.

data.title: Man U offers Old Trafford turf for sale
data.description: In a ⁠left-field ⁠move, Manchester United are ​offering supporters the chance to own a piece of the ​Old Trafford pitch, with ‌preserved sections of turf going on sale for £125 (5,800 baht).

data.title: Zverev, Agassi defend ‘spectacular’ Laver Cup
data.description: LONDON - Grand Slam champion Alexander Zverev and American legend Andre Agassi led a staunch defence of the Laver Cup ahead of the latest edition of the polarising event in London this week.

data.title: Pakistan braces for major pro-Khan protests
data.description: ISLAMABAD - Authorities in Pakistan’s capital blocked main access routes to the city with double-stacked shipping containers Thursday ahead of a weekend demonstration by supporters of jailed former prime minister Imran Khan.

data.title: Spain showdown a chance for England to heal World Cup ‘scar’
data.description: LONDON - The visit to Wembley by world champions Spain on Saturday will be a painful reminder to England of what might have been, but Thomas Tuchel needs a positive response to silence criticism of how the Three Lions’ World Cup ended.

data.title: ONE Championship: Superlek’s ‘let go’ post raises questions over kickboxing title
data.description: Superlek Kiatmoo9 has raised questions over the future of his ONE Championship flyweight kickboxing title with a cryptic social media message as he faces a lengthy recovery from knee surgery.

data.title: Peerawat steps in for injured Jonathan
data.description: Thailand head coach Anthony Hudson has called up Port defender Peerawat Akkrathum as a replacement for Jonathan Khemdee, who has been ruled out of the Fifa Asean Cup 2026 after sustaining a serious knee injury in training.

data.title: Club fined after pitch roller mishap
data.description: Pattani FC have been fined 50,000 baht by the Football Association of Thailand (FAT) following an incident in which PT Prachuap FC winger Andros Townsend was struck and run over by a pitch roller during the half-time of a Thai League match.

data.title: They came, they rode, they conquered
data.description: Thailand ended a 28-year wait for an Asian Games equestrian eventing team title on Wednesday, and backed it up with a clutch of further medals in skeet shooting, badminton, weightlifting and karate at Aichi-Nagoya 2026.

data.title: North Korea weightlifter sets three world records for Asian Games gold
data.description: NAGOYA — North Korea's Ri Song Gum gave her country their first gold of the Asian Games on Wednesday in style, setting three world records in the women's 49-kilogramme class in Nagoya, Japan.

data.title: Schoolgirl Yu, 13, fastest again in bid for third Asian Games gold
data.description: TOKYO - China's 13-year-old swimmer Yu Zidi went fastest in the heats as she closes in on a hat-trick of Asian Games golds on Wednesday -- and her team-mates say her stunning success is no longer a surprise.

data.title: ONE Championship: Rodtang, Nong-O join November flyweight Muay Thai grand prix
data.description: Thai stars Rodtang Jitmuangnon and Nong-O Hama will join Russian champion Asadula Imangazaliev in an eight-man ONE Championship flyweight Muay Thai world grand prix due to begin in November.

data.title: Football coach axed for telling female ref 'It's a man's game'
data.description: LOS ANGELES — Columbus Crew sacked Argentine reserve team coach Federico Higuain for telling a female referee "Don't forget this is a man's game" while refusing to release her from a handshake, the Major League Soccer (MLS) club said Tuesday.

data.title: World Cup 'not enough' as Spain begin next chapter
data.description: MADRID - Spain coach Luis de la Fuente will not allow the World Cup winners to rest on their laurels as they get back into action this week for the first time since their triumph.

data.title: 'New one' Klopp promises fresh approach as Germany reign begins
data.description: BERLIN - Germany coach Jurgen Klopp has promised to bring a "new approach" to the country's flagging fortunes, as the four-time world champions begin their latest tilt at a maiden Nations League title.

data.title: Hudson, Taylor reunite to help Thai team
data.description: Thailand head coach Anthony Hudson has announced the addition of Peter Taylor to the coaching staff to help the team in training and enhance the players' potential, specifically regarding physical conditioning.

data.title: The day I met The Squire in Florida
data.description: In this week's 'Paths Crossed', I remember when I was walking down a path towards the first tee of a tournament in Florida and I passed an elderly man wearing a hat. Something made me stop and turn around and I instantly recognised Gene Sarazen, one of the world's top players in the 1920s and 1930s, and the winner of seven major championships.

data.title: Thanongsak back in Japan to defend title
data.description: Thailand's lone world boxing champion Thanongsak Simsri returns to Japan on Saturday when he puts his IBF light flyweight title on the line against Filipino challenger Mark Vicelles at Fujisan Messe.

data.title: Kanjutha’s MMA gold a landmark moment
data.description: Thailand struck gold in unfamiliar territory on Tuesday as Kanjutha Phattaraboonsorn choked back tears to deliver a landmark mixed martial arts triumph, headlining a golden day for the Thai contingent at the 20th Asian Games Aichi-Nagoya 2026.

data.title: ONE Championship: Antonia Prifti wants Phetjeeja title shot rebooked after debut win
data.description: Greece’s Antonia Prifti wants her cancelled title shot against Phetjeeja Lukjaoporongtom rebooked after winning her ONE Championship debut.

data.title: Kanjutha's gold a landmark moment
data.description: Thailand struck gold in unfamiliar territory on Tuesday as Kanjutha Phattaraboonsorn choked back tears to deliver a landmark mixed martial arts triumph, headlining a golden day for the Thai contingent at the 20th Asian Games Aichi-Nagoya 2026.

data.title: No fear from Thai footballers as they target Japan
data.description: Thailand’s men’s football team close out their Asian Games group campaign against the host nation tonight, chasing not just pride but top spot, and Auttapon Sangthong is promising that the side, unburdened by pressure, will go toe-to-toe with the tournament favourites.

data.title: Thai badminton star challenges doping ruling
data.description: Thailand’s rising badminton star Pitchamon Opatniputh has moved swiftly to challenge her positive drug test, requesting an analysis of her B sample after becoming the first confirmed doping case of the Asian Games in Japan.

data.title: India’s women retain Asian Games cricket crown
data.description: NAGOYA, Japan - India’s dominant women retained their Asian Games cricket crown in style on Tuesday as an Afghan cyclist who once disguised herself as a man won a “special” silver.

data.title: ONE Championship unveils AI-powered rankings after overhaul
data.description: ONE Championship has unveiled AI-powered rankings for four Muay Thai divisions, restoring an official pecking order after removing its previous lists at the end of 2025.

data.title: Thai teams ‘all aware’ of doping rules, minister says after positive test
data.description: NAGOYA - Tourism and Sports Minister Surasak Phancharoenworakul ​said the nation's athletes at the Asian Games ​are all aware and ‌careful of doping rules following a failed drug test by one of the country's top badminton players.

data.title: Thailand says teams careful of doping rules after badminton player fails drug test
data.description: NAGOYA - Sports and Tourism Minister Surasak Phancharoenworakul ​said the nation's athletes at the Asian Games ​are all aware and ‌careful of doping rules following a failed drug test by one of the country's top badminton players.
